text:
olga: FYI saw a 3-4x jump in fncall validation rejects on /chat/invoke (us-west-2) starting ~10:03 PST.
kevin: Any variant/route info?
olga: route=router-v2, variant=short-ctx-degen. sample log: 2026-03-23T17:03:12Z id=abc123 status=validation_reject reason="output_shape_mismatch" details="expected object, got array"
ashley: Console only shows "validation_error" without reason dimension, makes triage hard.
diana: Finance flagged billing noise where rejects still appear billable. We mark tokens on arrival today.
sre-bot: alert: validation_error_rate crossed 3% in us-west-2 at 17:03:20Z
kevin: Proposal: add `validation_reason` enum and `validation_outcome` to invoke events; keep nullable and sample at 5% initially. Add `soft_validate` toggle for telemetry-only capture.
ashley: UX: add filter for reason and show one redacted failing example per bucket.
diana: billing rule: exclude events with validation_outcome==hard_reject after migration.
olga: suggest dynamic sampling override: capture 100% during anomaly windows until ack.
kevin: Action owners: runtime/emitter PR (kevin), canary config (olga), console index changes (ashley), billing draft (diana).
